summary: Snooze takes a chat out of Recents until a time or a pull request event, then brings it back with a Woke marker; the agent is never paused. This change is the backend, behind the staged flag chat_snooze (CHAT_SNOOZE_ENABLED in src/shared/chat-snooze.ts, false), so no client offers Snooze yet. Rules (src/shared/chat-snooze.ts, shared fixture tests/fixtures/chat-snooze-cases.json): the preset resolver (Later today: 3 hours rounded up to :00 or :30 and only while it ends today before 21:00; Tonight 20:00 while more than an hour away; Tomorrow morning 09:00; Next week the next Monday 09:00; soonest first; one item per minute), editable preset specs (time of day, weekday and time, duration; at most 8), pickPreset (a duration counts from the click, a clock time keeps the instant the menu showed and is refused once past), custom date and time validation that refuses a rolled-over date and a time a DST change skips and takes the first of a repeated one, wake labels, and shouldWakeOn: the time, an open card, a failure newer than the snooze, a message a person sent (Send to) after the snooze and a change of the watched PR wake it; a normal turn end, an agent's message and anything older than the snooze do not. Storage: conversations gains snoozed_until, snoozed_at, snooze_pr, snooze_pr_mark, snooze_rev, woke_at and woke_reason, written through resolveRootThreadId; snooze_rev moves on every change, so a stale timer or Undo is refused; a wake clears every snooze field in one statement and keeps the Woke marker apart. A user turn (turn acceptance or a stored user message), a settle and an archive clear the snooze and the marker in their own write; a snooze clears the settle in its write and broadcasts app:conversation-settled with settledAt null. ChatSnoozer (src/main/conversations/chat-snooze.ts) keeps one timer per timed snooze, capped at 2^31-1 ms, rebuilt at start, every 5 minutes and when the Mac wakes, so a snooze that ended while closed wakes on the next start; a timer whose revision moved does nothing. It runs on the desktop and on the headless server. The registry wakes a chat on request.opened, question.asked, plan.proposed and error (a turn's error, also one that comes right after its turn end, as a Claude query failure sends it), and on a peer message only when a person sent it, after the snooze (the time is taken before the send). A snooze is refused while the chat needs the user (an open card or an errored session). Channels app:snooze-conversation, app:unsnooze-conversation (Wake, and Undo with a revision), app:mark-woke-seen and the broadcast app:conversation-snoozed, open to a phone's chat scope; capability chat_snooze_v1. A wake on its time sends one push (kind woke) under the existing push policy; a card or an error already sends its own. PR wakes (feat/snooze-pr-wake): a snooze may name a linked PR by its prKey. The backend reads the PR when the snooze is made, refuses a merged or closed PR (pr_closed) or one it cannot read (pr_unreadable), checks again after the read that the chat is not archived and needs nothing, and stores the baseline (state, the host's update time, head commit, checks failed, newest changes request) in the same write as the snooze revision. While any snoozed chat waits on a PR, the snoozer reads each such PR every 5 minutes, one read per PR, in series; with none waiting the timer stops and nothing is read. Only three events wake, each forward from the baseline (prWakeSummary): the PR merged; a review requested changes after the newest one in the baseline (the host's times compared with each other, never with the local clock); the checks failed on a head that had not failed (a new push that fails counts). Comments, approvals and pushes alone do not wake, and what the baseline already shows (changes requested, failed checks) does not wake. A read older than the baseline (a stale cache) wakes nothing; a failed read is logged and tried at the next tick; a wake uses the snooze revision, so a chat re-snoozed during a read is not woken. A merge first runs the Settle on merge rule on that chat, linked or not, so an idle chat settles (the Settle notice) and its snooze ends there with no wake and no push; a busy one wakes with 'PR #n merged' and one push; a merge and the snooze time that fall together give one outcome and one push. Every settle broadcast names the snooze it ended (endedSnooze: until, pr and the revision after the settle); its Undo snoozes again with those values and expectRev, which also unsettles, and a PR that is no longer open keeps only the time (a PR-only snooze is refused, pr_closed). Reviews list reads and turn-end link reads do not feed the PR comparison; a merge they find settles an idle snoozed chat through Settle on merge.

desktop.followUpRelease: The Snooze sidebar release (feat/snooze-sidebar), which adds the row buttons, menu, Snoozed group, Woke marker and undo notice and turns CHAT_SNOOZE_ENABLED on for the desktop.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: The Snooze phones release (feat/snooze-phones): Home > Recents filter, the Snoozed shelf with Wake, long-press presets, the Woke mark and app:mark-woke-seen, only against a backend with chat_snooze_v1.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: The Snooze phones release (feat/snooze-phones): ChatSnooze.kt runs tests/fixtures/chat-snooze-cases.json, and HomePresenter gains the filter, the shelf, the long-press menu and the Woke mark.

updateRelease.reason: Nothing user-visible ships in this change: the flag is off and no client offers Snooze. The sidebar release adds the CHANGELOG and docs/features.md entries.

automated: tests/unit/chat-snooze-rules.test.ts: the shared fixture for presets (Sunday, Monday, 17:29, 17:45, 18:59, 19:00, 20:59 on 31 December, custom presets), pickPreset across midnight and after the time, wake labels, custom times (past, rolled-over dates, bad clocks, too far), shouldWakeOn and preset parsing; a child process in America/New_York refuses 02:30 on 14 March 2027 and takes 01:30 EDT on 1 November 2026.

tests/unit/chat-snooze-db.test.ts: the migration adds the seven columns to a database from before them and runs again with no change; writes and reads go to the root row through a rotated id; a wake clears every snooze field together and keeps the marker, seen never brings the snooze back; a revision that moved refuses a write; a user message, a turn accepted under a rotated id, a settle and the archive write end the snooze; an assistant message does not; a snooze clears the settle.

tests/unit/chat-snooze-timer.test.ts (fake clock, real database): wake at the time with one push and a broadcast; refusals (needs you, past, too far, empty, no row); a stale timer after a re-snooze; timers rebuilt on a restart and a snooze that ended while closed woken at once; the 2^31-1 ms cap; resync; early wakes on a card and a newer failure but not on an agent message, a normal end or an older failure; Undo of a wake refused once the revision moved or the time passed; seen and archive; a person message sent before the snooze does not wake it; snoozing a settled chat broadcasts the unsettle; a settle still succeeds when the snooze cleanup throws. tests/unit/chat-snooze-registry.test.ts: a Claude query failure (turn end, then error) wakes, a normal end and a later error with no turn do not, and a peer message carries its pre-send time. tests/unit/atomic-user-turn-submission.test.ts: a committed turn is accepted and published when the snooze cleanup throws.

tests/unit/chat-snooze-rules.test.ts prWake fixture cases (merged, closed, changes requested before and after the snooze, checks failed, already failed on that head, failed again on a new push, a push alone, comments and an approval, a cached read older than the baseline, a merge outranking the rest); tests/unit/chat-snooze-timer.test.ts with a fake PR reader and a fake clock: baseline stored and closed or unreadable PRs refused, a read every 5 minutes, a wake with one push on changes requested and no reads after it, one read for two chats on the same PR, a failed or throwing read tried again, a baseline that already shows changes requested and failed checks wakes only on a new event, an older cached read wakes nothing, a re-snooze during the read is not woken, a merge that settles an idle chat through storeConversationSettled (no wake, no push) and its Undo restoring the time, a merge racing the snooze time with one push, a merge that wakes a busy chat, no reads when no chat waits on a PR, and the settle broadcast naming the snooze it ended.
notExercised: No client calls the channels yet (flag off); the sidebar and phones releases exercise them in the app.
PR wakes were not run against a real GitHub or Bitbucket pull request; the reads go through the same service detail read the Reviews page uses.
